title: zl.group
description: group elements into lists of a given size

messages.description: outputs and clears the remaining stored elements

methods.description: clears the mode's arguments and the data received in both inlets
sets the maximum list size, 1 to 32767

body: [zl.group] collects incoming elements into lists of 'n' elements, where 'n' can't be larger than the maximum list size. Each time a group is full it goes out the left outlet, and the remaining elements are kept for the next one. A bang outputs and clears what's stored. The argument or the right inlet sets the group size.
